bahrain.title: Two injured and industrial site set ablaze in new Iranian attacks on Bahrain
bahrain.summary: The Interior Ministry said Saturday's Iranian attacks injured two people, a Bahraini citizen in stable condition and a Pakistani resident in critical condition. A strike on an industrial facility caused a fire that Civil Defence worked to contain. Kuwait and Jordan condemned the attacks.

bahrain.title: MPs urged to reject BD 100,000 minimum capital rule for foreign-owned firms
bahrain.summary: A proposal requiring wholly foreign-owned companies to hold at least BD 100,000 in share capital heads to a parliamentary vote. Parliament's financial and economic affairs committee warned a blanket rule across all sectors could deter foreign investment and slow growth.

bahrain.title: GCC-UK free trade deal expected to lift trade by up to 20%
bahrain.summary: Bahrain's ambassador to the UK said the GCC-UK Free Trade Agreement, once in force, should raise annual trade between the two sides, now about $60 billion, by 17% to 20%.

bahrain.title: New fines to enforce tax transparency rules on three types of firms
bahrain.summary: Industry and Commerce Minister Abdulla Fakhro said Resolution 54 of 2026 sets administrative fines for breaches of Economic Substance, Common Reporting Standard and Country-by-Country Reporting rules, applying only to three specific categories of businesses under Bahrain's global obligations.

bahrain.title: NBB commits to paying SME suppliers within 15 working days
bahrain.summary: National Bank of Bahrain will settle invoices from small and medium-sized suppliers within 15 working days of upload, after talks with Bahrain Chamber, aiming to ease cash-flow pressure on smaller businesses.

bahrain.title: Arla Foods advances $60 million production line expansion in Bahrain
bahrain.summary: Ministers and the EDB chief toured Arla Foods' plant at Bahrain International Investment Park, where the Golden Licence holder is adding a new production line in a project worth more than $60 million.

bahrain.title: Proposal for public drop-off spaces for unwanted household items sparks debate
bahrain.summary: Capital Trustees Board chairman Saleh Tarradah proposed a network of open spaces where residents can leave old furniture, appliances and other items for others to collect, cutting waste sent to landfill. Municipal officials are divided on the idea.

crypto.title: Bitcoin drops below $60,000 for first time since July amid tech selloff
crypto.summary: Bitcoin fell as low as $58,811 on Friday, down nearly 30% in a month, as the Nasdaq slid over 5% and US spot Bitcoin ETFs lost $582 million in a day. CoinShares blamed the AI stock rout and high rates. CoinDesk reports it later recovered above $60,000 after $1.8 billion in liquidations.

crypto.title: Bitcoin flash-crashes to about $17,000 on Kraken's Canadian dollar market
crypto.summary: Heavy selling on Kraken's Canadian dollar pairs briefly pushed Bitcoin to the equivalent of about $16,900, some 71% below its US dollar price. Kraken found no breach and said executed trades will stand.

crypto.title: Chainflip confirms $12 million vault hack and offers attacker 10% bounty
crypto.summary: The cross-chain swap protocol said about $12 million in BTC, ETH and stablecoins was stolen on Saturday, up from an early $4.86 million estimate. It gave the attacker until 23 November to return 90%, and its FLIP token fell about 43%.

crypto.title: US Senate passes bill banning prediction market bets on war and death
crypto.summary: The DEATH BETS Act would bar CFTC-registered exchanges from listing contracts tied to war, terrorism, assassination, US military operations or a person's death. It passed by voice vote and now goes to the House.

crypto.title: Hong Kong bill would license crypto dealers, advisers, managers and custodians
crypto.summary: Hong Kong published a bill requiring firms dealing, advising, managing or holding virtual assets to be licensed or registered with the SFC, extending oversight beyond exchanges. It goes to the Legislative Council for a first reading on 2 December.

crypto.title: Binance hackers move nearly $600 million in Ether through cross-chain protocols
crypto.summary: Wallets tied to the $6.3 billion Binance hack, linked to North Korea, shifted about $594 million in ETH over two days, routing some through THORChain and Chainflip. They still hold about $394 million in ETH.
